sloka: सर्वेषां ब्रह्मदण्डानामवध्यो ऽयं भविष्यति ।दीर्घायुश्च महात्मा च इति ब्रह्माब्रवीद्वचः ।। ७.३६.१९ ॥
transliteration: sarveṣāṁ brahmadaṇḍānāmavadhyo 'yaṁ bhaviṣyati ।dīrghāyuśca mahātmā ca iti brahmābravīdvacaḥ ।। 7.36.19 ॥

translations.english: Brahma then spoke, declaring that this child would be immune to all of Brahma's curses and would be long-lived and great-souled.
